_comment: Feature 140 Web Push contract. Each backend uses a real local HTTP endpoint; no provider or crypto mock is permitted.

invariants.rule: Key generation returns a base64url P-256 public key (65 raw bytes, uncompressed) and private key (32 raw bytes).
send(subscription, payload) POSTs an aes128gcm encrypted body with VAPID authorization and returns the normalized result envelope for HTTP 201.
HTTP 404 and 410 return ok=false, dead=true, retryable=false without hiding the endpoint or status.
HTTP 408, 429, and 5xx return retryable=true while preserving the response status.
Missing VAPID configuration, malformed subscription keys, and unavailable optional crypto fail loudly before delivery.
tina4-js serializes the browser-native PushSubscription shape and decodes the application server key without adding a runtime dependency.
